identity.name: Zelos Horizon V2 300M Bronze
identity.one_liner: A Singaporean microbrand's bronze dive watch — 300m water resistance, ceramic bezel, and the patina bronze in a 40mm case for under $600.

narrative.story: Zelos is run by a Singaporean watch collector who started the brand in 2014 with a successful Kickstarter. The Horizon line is the brand's most-cited dive watch: a 40mm bronze case (CuSn6, a marine bronze that ages green-blue in salt water), a 300m water resistance, a ceramic unidirectional bezel, and a Miyota 9015 movement. The brand is the most-cited SEA-headquartered microbrand in international dive-watch collector circles, and the Horizon V2 is its 2023 update. The company operates as a true microbrand — most production runs are 100–300 pieces.
narrative.collector_notes: CuSn6 bronze is the same alloy used by Tudor for the Black Bay Bronze. The ceramic bezel insert uses luminous markers. The case comes on a leather strap and a rubber dive strap. Production runs are 100–300 pieces per dial color.
